POOJA SHREESHAIL BEERALDINNI 
Lead Business Analyst / Product Owner 
Pune, Maharashtra, India | beeraldinnipooja@gmail.com | +91 8087771254 
 
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
 
Dynamic and impact-driven Lead Business Analyst/Product Owner with 8+ years of experience leading cross-functional teams, 
driving platform modernization, and delivering enterprise-grade SaaS and automated solutions. Proven track record of 
bridging the gap between business strategy and technical execution across Banking & Financial Services (Citi, Payments) and 
Enterprise Software (ServiceNow, GCP). Adept at managing end-to-end product lifecycles, owning product backlogs, 
automating high-risk workflows, and orchestrating Agile/Scrum delivery to drive 80%+ efficiency gains and 100% client 
satisfaction. Certified IIBA AAC professional skilled in GenAI integration, process re-engineering, and strategic stakeholder 
management. 
CORE COMPETENCIES 
 
● Product & Project Ownership: Product Backlog Ownership, User Story Mapping & Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin/Given-
When-Then), Strategic Product Roadmapping, Project Scoping & Lifecycle Management, Feature Prioritization (MoSCoW, 
RICE, Kano), Solution Architecture, Risk Mitigation & EUC Remediation. 
● Requirements & Systems Analysis: Functional & Technical Specifications (BRD, FRD, FSD), As-Is / To-Be Process Mapping, 
Gap Analysis, Root Cause Analysis (5 Whys, Fishbone), Data Modeling, System Architecture Diagrams, API Scoping & 
Integration Mapping. 
● Domain & Business Strategy: Banking & Financial Services (Payments & Receivables), Regulatory & Compliance 
Automation, HRIS/HCM Systems, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Business Process Re-Engineering (BPR), ROI 
& Feasibility Assessment. 
● Agile & Stakeholder Management: Scrum & Kanban Frameworks, Cross-functional Team Leadership, Executive 
Stakeholder Engagement & Design Workshops, User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Strategy & Governance, Change 
Management (CRs), Change Impact Assessment. 
● Technical Tools & Analytics: SQL, GCP BigQuery, Teradata, Postman (API Testing), Visio, Jira & Confluence, Workato, 
ServiceNow, Salesforce, Workday, Zendesk, Power BI, GenAI Implementation.
